en: A sports-themed postcard featuring a close-up action photograph of cross-country skier Andrus Veerpalu competing at the Winter Olympics. He wears a white racing suit, red bib with Olympic rings, and skis in snowy conditions. The Olympic rings logo appears at the top left, his printed name at the top right, and his black autograph near the top. At the lower left is an attached commemorative postage stamp with his portrait, flowers, Olympic rings, Estonian text, and postal cancellation marks.
